I set 35 of my 36 rows to IMPLEMENTED with evidence. The 36th, REQ-PB-090, stays SPECIFIED because it has a real gap that needs a repair. Everything is left uncommitted, as the assignment asks.

**Preceding gate:** `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG4` printed `PASS gate DG4 (historical)`, exit 0.

**What changed in the register:**
- Only my 36 rows differ from the base (`f78afff`). The script confirms no other row, held row or locked column changed.
- All 36 rows got the "DG5 analyst check (T-DG5-AN-P5A, base f78afff): …" sentence added after their existing notes. Each sentence names the test that asserts the acceptance clause and says where coverage is only partial: REQ-PB-093 (the exact 30/20/20/15/15 weights are never entered end to end in the browser), REQ-PB-087 (the Day-90 screen has only a component test), REQ-S05-006, REQ-S01-004 and REQ-DLV-037.
- I opened every cited test before using it. Several QA "partial" findings have since been closed by later fixes, and I recorded those too: QA-C G1 for REQ-S09-011 and QA-B P-1 for REQ-S07-016, among others.
- I added no "P5 increment delivered" notes to later-gate rows. No P5 or QA handback names any of those 52 rows by ID, which the assignment requires.

**The gap, REQ-PB-090:** the acceptance requires the traceability view to show the five-step line ending "Attach rate / activation -> Revenue uplift". The demo data actually produces six steps ending "Roaming attach rate -> Roaming revenue uplift". The existing test checks only the first four labels word for word. The BE-T handback (§6 item 1) proposed a one-line rename, and no decision from D-161 to D-167 took it up. The fix is either that rename or a decision accepting the six-step line, plus a test that checks the exact text.

**Checks (all run in this tree):**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --register DG5` | Exit 1: 86 problems across 43 rows. 36 are the other half's rows, 6 are held rows, and 1 is REQ-PB-090. None of my 35 IMPLEMENTED rows fails. |
| `validate.mjs --register DG4`, `DG3`, `DG2` | All PASS, exit 0 |
| CSV integrity | 412 rows, 19 columns on every row, header unchanged, strict parse OK, re-serialises byte-identical |
| Only my rows changed | 36 rows changed, all mine; nothing outside `status`, `evidence` and `notes` |
| Evidence paths | 397 checked, none missing |
| `git diff --stat` | Only `docs/delivery/requirements.csv`, plus the new handback file |

I didn't re-run any product test suites. The evidence relies on the orchestrator's merged-tree runs: the D-167 integration run, whose 3 failures are held or other-half rows, and the D-166 end-to-end runs. The W21 end-to-end results arrive with W22's verification.

The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-AN-P5A-transformation-analyst.md`. It has the per-row clause-to-test table and the validator and script outputs. Some untracked dotfiles at the top of the repository (`.zshrc`, `.vscode`, `CLAUDE.local.md` and others) are not mine, and I left them alone.
